material.acceptance_criteria: Each expanded team-strip hero row shows whole hp equal to the select panel's health number for the same hero at the same tick.
material.description: Symptom: the expanded team strip prints each hero's hp as a Q16.16 integer (550 hp reads as 36044800) while the select and HUD panels show whole hp. Cause: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:318 prints h.hp unscaled; h.hp is unit_hp stored at panels.lua:194 and is Q16.16 (config.FIX = 65536, scenarios/moba/shared/config.lua:3). The same module divides by config.FIX at panels.lua:230 and :483. Rivals: unit_hp returns whole hp (rejected: mods/bot_probe.lua:30 and :37 divide unit_hp by 65536); the select and HUD sites are wrong (rejected: they divide by FIX). Representation leaks past the hp accessor into the team strip.

notes.note: Duplicate of MILNER-trav-hud-lua-L1-1 (same team-strip hp scale defect at panels.lua:318). Merge into MILNER-trav-hud-lua-L1-1 by the owner.

material.resolution: Stale: the team strip no longer prints per-hero hp rows (22fc7e2d, hud-team-strip-dota-compact); the raw fixed-point print is gone, so no fix is needed in panels.lua.
material.subject: Team strip expanded rows show raw fixed-point hp, not hp
material.witness: Premise absent on origin/main and the working tree: codesearch literal 'label(tostring(h.hp' over scenarios/moba = 0 matches (99 files, exhaustive). panels.lua has no per-hero team-strip rows: team_tree (panels.lua:281) prints only kills and the clock, after 22fc7e2d cut the strip. Remaining hp labels divide by config.FIX (panels.lua:231, 479). Row's cited line 318 (tostring(h.hp)) was removed by 22fc7e2d.
material.witness_plan: Live: select a hero, expand the team strip, compare the hero's row hp with the select panel health number at the same tick.
